world.h: Iran vows to use 'all available means' against US blockade
world.b: Iran says it will use all means at its disposal to counter the US naval blockade imposed during the nine-month US-Israel war on Iran.
world.title: Iran says it will use ‘all available means’ to counter US blockade

world.h: LIVE: Tankers set ablaze in Hormuz as IRGC warns of unrest
world.b: Tankers have been set ablaze in the Strait of Hormuz as Iran's Revolutionary Guard warns of a threat of unrest. Follow Al Jazeera's live coverage.
world.title: Escalation threat as Hormuz Strait stalemate stokes Iran-US war fears

national.h: States race to explain new Medicaid work requirements
national.b: Starting next year, roughly 20 million people will need to prove they're working, volunteering, in school or exempt to keep Medicaid under last year's tax and spending law.
national.title: Medicaid work requirements are coming. How are states getting the word out?

national.h: Immigrant abuse survivors weigh calling 911 against deportation
national.b: Amid an immigration crackdown in west Michigan, ProPublica heard from immigrant women in abusive relationships about how they calculate their safety. Some are afraid to leave the house.
national.title: If They Call 911 About Domestic Abuse, Will They Be Deported?

national.h: Thanksgiving as we know it was invented amid the Civil War
national.b: The familiar Pilgrim story is taught as history, but the only eyewitness account of the 1621 harvest says little about the meal. Today's holiday took shape during the Civil War as a bid to unite a divided country.

national.h: Delta automation glitch delays more than half its flights
national.b: Well over half of Delta flights were delayed Sunday afternoon after a problem with the system that calculates aircraft weight. Delta said the system was later restored, though flights were not yet back to normal.

national.h: Appeals court strikes down pregnant worker protections law
national.b: The 5th Circuit ruled 9-8 that Congress violated the Constitution in passing the 2022 Pregnant Workers Fairness Act. Advocates say the ruling invalidates the law in Texas, Louisiana and Mississippi and could imperil it elsewhere.

politics.h: Oath Keepers founder Stewart Rhodes says he's 'done' with Trump
politics.b: Stewart Rhodes, who went to prison for his role in Jan. 6, now calls Trump a traitor and "one of the very worst in our nation's history."
politics.title: 'One of the very worst.' Jan. 6 leader Stewart Rhodes says he is 'absolutely done' with Trump

politics.h: California voters reject billionaire tax despite progressive wins
politics.b: Voters rejected Proposition 40, a one-time 5% tax on billionaires' wealth, 52% to 48%, and narrowly approved a measure making such taxes much harder to enact in the future.
politics.title: How a billionaire tax proposal failed in California despite big election wins for progressives

politics.h: Trump to host third private dinner for top meme coin holders
politics.b: President Trump will host a third private dinner for the largest investors in his $TRUMP meme coin, reigniting questions about conflicts of interest in his crypto ventures.

politics.h: Intelligence chief defends Trump calling Putin a 'friend'
politics.b: Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton said it was "entirely appropriate" for President Trump to call Vladimir Putin his friend, after last week's three-way summit with Putin and Xi Jinping in China.

politics.h: Democrats clinch largest House majority since 1992
politics.b: House Democrats have won at least 258 seats, gaining 44 so far, their best general election result in decades and four more seats than they picked up in 2018.

politics.h: Christian nationalists see GOP losses as a chance to supplant MAGA
politics.b: Christian nationalists who celebrated Trump's return now see the Republican Party's recent election losses as an opportunity to replace his MAGA movement with their own extremist vision.
politics.title: Christian nationalists see GOP midterm losses as opportunity to supplant Trump's MAGA

international.h: At least 15 killed in Kyiv region as Russia steps up attacks
international.b: The death toll from Russian attacks in Ukraine's Kyiv region has risen to at least 15, including at a partially destroyed apartment building in the town of Dymer.
international.title: At least 15 killed in Ukraine’s Kyiv region as Russia intensifies attacks

international.h: Rights group says attacks on West Bank medics up 350%
international.b: Physicians for Human Rights Israel says Palestinian healthcare staff in the occupied West Bank are increasingly coming under attack from Israeli soldiers and settlers.
international.title: Israeli attacks on medics in occupied West Bank surge by 350%: Rights group

international.h: Belgian strike set to ground nearly all flights
international.b: Belgium's air traffic controller Skeyes said its staff will join a national strike against austerity measures, suspending regular service at the country's airports from 7am to 9pm Monday.

international.h: Indonesia confirms 24 dead in candy factory fire
international.b: Authorities confirmed 24 deaths in the fire that gutted the Fonusa Agung Mulia factory in Banten province, with about 30 people still missing. A presidential adviser said a short circuit in an air conditioner may be to blame.

international.h: Zelenskyy says Ukraine sank Russian ship off Libya
international.b: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy confirmed Ukraine sank the Russian ship Merkury off the Libyan coast, hailing an "exemplary Ukrainian operation" after the strike at Benghazi port.
international.title: Zelenskyy says Ukraine was behind drone attacks on Russian ships off Libya

international.h: WHO chief urges peace as fighting disrupts Congo Ebola response
international.b: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said fighting near a hospital in Ituri province, the epicentre of DR Congo's Ebola outbreak, disrupted response efforts and forced health workers to shelter in a maternity ward.

international.h: Likud and Eisenkot's Yashar end coalition talks without a deal
international.b: Caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's Likud and Gadi Eisenkot's Yashar party ended coalition talks in Israel without reaching an agreement.

international.h: Poland says Russia also targeted Ukrainian American rapper
international.b: Polish authorities say the Ukrainian American man Denmark says it saved from an alleged Russian murder plot was also targeted by Moscow's intelligence services last summer in Poland. Denmark has expelled a Russian official.

international.h: Lebanese villagers return to homes wrecked during Israeli occupation
international.b: As the Israeli army pulls back in southern Lebanon, families in Zawtar al-Gharbiyah are returning to find homes they say Israeli forces demolished after the US-brokered ceasefire.

international.h: Zelenskyy urges US to release Patriots as Russian strikes kill 7
international.b: Russian attacks killed seven people in Ukraine, including in Dymer in the Kyiv region, as President Zelenskyy urged the US to release Patriot missiles.

international.h: Drone attacks kill four around Khartoum, damage UN building
international.b: Drone attacks blamed on Sudan's paramilitary Rapid Support Forces killed four people in and around Khartoum and damaged a United Nations building, according to local reports and UN officials.

international.h: COP31 climate talks in Antalya end without a deal
international.b: The UN climate conference in Antalya, Turkey, ended Sunday without an agreement after disagreements over fossil fuels, and delegates called the outcome disappointing.

international.h: Settlers attack Palestinian villages in occupied West Bank
international.b: Israeli settlers attacked several Palestinian towns and villages in the central occupied West Bank, including Kafr Malik, burning cars and damaging property.

international.h: Russian cargo ship still burning off Finland after drone strike
international.b: Fire aboard the Sparta II, struck by drones Saturday off Finland's coast, burned through the night, the Finnish coastguard said. Finland's military says Ukraine likely carried out the strike; the 16 crew were evacuated.

international.h: Displaced Palestinians protest Israeli strikes in Gaza
international.b: Hundreds of displaced Palestinians living near the "Yellow Line" in Gaza demonstrated Saturday as Israeli forces continued air strikes and destroyed buildings beyond the ceasefire line.

international.h: Eleven killed in Sinaloa operation to capture cartel boss
international.b: Mexico's Defence Ministry said seven alleged cartel gunmen and four soldiers were killed in the overnight operation in Sinaloa that captured Fausto Isidro Meza Flores.

business.h: Nvidia board reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO and chairman
business.b: Nvidia's board unanimously reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO and chairman, saying it is in the best interest of the company.
business.title: Nvidia board unanimously reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO and chairman

business.h: What Thanksgiving dinner costs this year
business.b: Grocery prices have risen nearly 22% over five years, driven by wars, tariffs and severe weather, but food-price experts say it's unclear whether this year's Thanksgiving meal will cost more.
business.title: Let's talk turkey: Here's how Thanksgiving meal costs have changed this year

business.h: Seniors embrace Tesla's automated driving despite safety concerns
business.b: Older drivers are using Tesla's Full Self-Driving (Supervised) to stay on the road longer, but safety experts warn the company may be overselling what its cars can do.
business.title: Seniors embrace Tesla automated driving technology despite questions about safety

business.h: Meta's AI chief warns superintelligence is 'arriving'
business.b: Meta's top AI executive warned that superintelligence far exceeding human intellect is imminent and sounded the alarm about the risk of humanity losing control of AI.
business.title: Artificial superintelligence ‘arriving’, warns top Meta executive

business.h: Asian markets slide as AI bubble fears mount
business.b: Markets in South Korea, Hong Kong and mainland China fell deeper on Monday, extending Friday's tech-led sell-off. Seoul's Kospi slid as much as 5.8 percent before paring losses.
business.title: Asian stock markets tumble as AI bubble fears mount

business.h: How a small-business loan became a seven-year nightmare
business.b: Merchant cash advances are America's fastest-growing source of small-business funding and one of the least regulated. NPR follows Vahe Shahinian's seven-year fight over a deal he alleges was fraud.
business.title: He expected a small-business loan. He got a 7-year nightmare

business.h: Paolo Bulgari, who built a global jewelry brand, dies at 89
business.b: Paolo Bulgari, grandson of a Greek silversmith, helped turn the family jewelry business into a global luxury brand. His family announced his death Saturday, calling him "the greatest jeweler of our time."

science.h: Mushroom supplements promise a lot. What does the science say?
science.b: NPR looks at the evidence behind popular mushroom supplements such as lion's mane and reishi.
science.title: Mushroom supplements promise health benefits. What does the science say?

science.h: What makes Challenger Deep the ocean's deepest spot
science.b: The roughly 11,000-meter valley in the Mariana Trench sits where the Pacific plate dives beneath the Mariana plate. Researchers are working out why it runs deeper than other subduction zones.
science.title: Motion under the ocean explains the depth of the world’s deepest spot

science.h: Halted research funds strain trust in Black communities
science.b: Scientists are fighting to restore halted grants, including for Alzheimer's research in a historically Black part of Pittsburgh, where participants took memory tests and shared their stories. Rebuilding trust may be harder.

science.h: Two spacecraft slip into orbit around Mercury
science.b: The European-Japanese BepiColombo mission entered orbit around Mercury on Saturday after an eight-year cruise. The two linked probes will separate next month to study the planet from different altitudes.

sports.h: Prochazka meets Stirling in UFC main event in Qatar
sports.b: Former light heavyweight champion Jiri Prochazka faces rising star Navajo Stirling in Saturday's UFC Fight Night main event in Qatar. Stirling is seeking his fourth win of 2026.

goodnews.h: NPR's first Senior Podcast Challenge draws early entries
goodnews.b: People over 65 have been sending NPR podcasts about life after retirement for its first-ever Senior Podcast Challenge.

goodnews.h: Kids in Johannesburg's Alexandra township publish their own book
goodnews.b: Children in the Read Alex literacy program in Johannesburg wrote a new book of short stories drawn from their own lives, From Gomora to the World.

local.h: New film captures ICE agents' banter at NYC courthouse arrests
local.b: Filmmaker Emma V.F. recorded scores of arrests at 26 Federal Plaza, along with the rarely seen small talk among the ICE agents making them.
local.title: New film captures ICE agents' banter amid NYC courthouse arrests

local.h: Citi Bike e-bike rides to be capped at $3.65 for members
local.b: Under a new deal between Mayor Zohran Mamdani's administration and Lyft, Citi Bike members will pay no more than $3.65 for e-bike rides up to 45 minutes starting Jan. 19, 2027.
local.title: NYC Citi Bike member rides to be capped at $3.65 after Mamdani inks new deal with Lyft

local.h: Abandoned dog family found in the cold in Orange, NJ
local.b: Animal protection officers found two dogs tied to a fence in Orange, just west of Newark, along with five newborn puppies. One puppy died, the Associated Humane Societies said.
local.title: 1 puppy dead, another fighting for its life after dog family abandoned in NJ cold

local.h: Aber Kawas becomes first Palestinian in New York state Senate
local.b: Aber Kawas won election as the first Palestinian in New York Senate history, celebrating with hundreds of Democratic Socialists of America members on election night.

local.h: Jersey City rent control push ends in setback for DSA members
local.b: A bill from progressive Jersey City council members to protect tenants of a waterfront high-rise from rent hikes was tossed before it could be formally introduced.
local.title: A rush to rent control in Jersey City ends in a setback for DSA council members

periods.name: Wednesday Night
periods.text: Mostly cloudy, with a steady temperature around 49. Breezy.

localgood.h: About 100 New Yorkers ditched their smartphones for a month
localgood.b: A phone-free party celebrated roughly 100 New Yorkers who gave up their smartphones for a month, with a showcase of the hobbies and art projects they picked up instead.
localgood.title: These New Yorkers ditched their smartphones for a month. No, seriously.

localgood.h: Adopt a storm drain? Council bill would enlist New Yorkers
localgood.b: A City Council bill would let residents volunteer to clear leaves and litter from storm drains on their block, building on a pilot in Greenpoint, Brooklyn, to help prevent flooding.
localgood.title: Adopt a storm drain? NYC proposal aims to enlist residents in flood prevention.
